text.en:
Act Numbered One hundred and twenty-five, extending the provisions of the Provincial
Government Act to the Province of Marinduque, is hereby amended by increasing the limit of allowance for
necessary and actual traveling expenses of provincial officers while absent from the capital of the province
on official business from one dollar per day, in money of the United States, as now provided, to two dollars
and fifty cents per day, in the same currency.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 25, 1901.
